notes: Read all 318 source lines with line numbers before porting. Header behavior-contract doc (L1-18) preserved + extended in the native file header. Imports (L20-34): useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState kept; useTranslation (react-i18next, L21) -> local fallback useTranslation returning {t,i18n:{language:'en'}} with {{var}} interpolation (native ships no i18n runtime); lucide CalendarIcon/ChevronDown (L22) -> calendar glyph omitted to match the web `hidden`/phone rendering + a text '\u25BE' chevron stands in for ChevronDown; react-day-picker DayPicker/DateRange + its CSS (L23-24) -> DOM calendar has no native analog, replaced by two controlled YYYY-MM-DD TextInputs (StagedRange = {from?:Date;to?:Date} replaces DateRange); Button (L25) -> internal FooterButton Pressable (primary/ghost); Popover (L26) -> bottom-pinned native Modal sheet (the documented mobile bottom-sheet rendering); cn (L27) -> StyleSheet; datePresets DATE_PRESETS/DEFAULT_PRESET_IDS/getDatePreset/matchPresetId/resolveAllTimeStart (L28-34) -> faithful inline DOM-free copies (full 11-entry table + helpers).

Types ported verbatim: RangePickerValue (L36-39: start,end). RangePickerProps (L41-76) all 13 fields preserved on the public type -- value, onChange(value,presetId?), presetIds (default DEFAULT_PRESET_IDS), minDate, maxDate, enableCompare (default false), compare (default false), onCompareChange, size (default 'sm'), align, className, triggerTestId, presetsOnly (default false). align + className are accepted for API parity but intentionally NOT destructured/consumed: the native bottom sheet has no horizontal popover anchor and RN has no DOM className (documented in their JSDoc + this sidecar), which also keeps lint clean of unused vars.

Helper functions carried across unchanged: isoFromDate (L78-83), dateFromIso local-day construction (L85-89), diffDaysInclusive (L91-95), formatRange with Intl.DateTimeFormat short month/day +/- year and the en-dash join (L97-110) -- Intl is available under Hermes/Node so kept verbatim.

Component body (L112-197): same destructured signature + defaults (minus align/className); const {t,i18n}=useTranslation() (L127) preserved; triggerRef useRef<View> (L128) attached to the trigger Pressable for name parity (web HTMLButtonElement anchor ref); open state (L129) preserved; staged StagedRange state (L132) preserved + two startDraft/endDraft text buffers added for the TextInput substitute; reset-on-open useEffect with [open,value.start,value.end] deps (L135-139) preserved and also seeds the drafts; activePresetId useMemo (L141-144), activePreset/activeLabel (L145-148), presets useMemo([presetIds]) (L150-153), handlePreset with the 'all'->resolveAllTimeStart(minDate) branch + onChange(r,preset.id)+close (L155-164), handleApply with the !from/!to guard + start>end guard + onChange({start,end})+close (L166-173), handleCancel setStaged(undefined)+close (L175-178, drafts also cleared), stagedDirty (L180-183), stagedDays (L185-188), triggerLabel/triggerSubLabel/totalDays/dayCount (L190-193), minDateObj/maxDateObj (L195-196) all preserved verbatim. handleStartText/handleEndText reconcile a valid YYYY-MM-DD draft into staged.from/to (the native equivalent of DayPicker onSelect).

Render (L198-318): the DOM trigger <button> (L200-221, aria-haspopup/aria-expanded/aria-label/title/data-testid + CalendarIcon + label + `hidden sm:inline` subLabel + ChevronDown) -> <Pressable> with accessibilityRole=button, accessibilityState.expanded=open, accessibilityLabel='Date range', accessibilityHint=`${triggerSubLabel} \u00B7 ${dayCount}` (the web title), testID=triggerTestId, the active-preset label + '\u25BE' chevron (calendar glyph + subLabel dropped for phone parity); size sm/md drives trigger height/padding/text. The Popover (L223-315) -> Modal(transparent,fade,onRequestClose=close) + backdrop Pressable(close) + bottom sheet; preset <ul role=listbox> (L233-260) -> horizontal ScrollView of Pressable pills (role=button, accessibilityState.selected, testID=range-preset-<id>, blue active highlight) calling handlePreset; the !presetsOnly DayPicker+footer block (L263-313) -> staged-range TextInputs (range-picker-start/end) + a bounds hint approximating fromDate/toDate min/max, then the footer: enableCompare checkbox <label><input type=checkbox> (L280-289) -> Pressable role=checkbox (accessibilityState.checked=compare) firing onCompareChange(!compare), else the stagedDays span (L291-295) -> range-picker-days AppText, then Cancel(ghost)/Apply(primary,disabled=!stagedDirty) Buttons (L297-310) -> FooterButton Pressables (range-picker-cancel/apply). Component close (L316-318) complete.

Browser-only affordances documented: react-day-picker's two-month grid, numberOfMonths window.innerWidth logic, showOutsideDays, weekStartsOn, and fromDate/toDate day-disabling have no native analog without a date-picker dependency; the controlled YYYY-MM-DD TextInputs are the native-safe substitute that preserves the stage-then-Apply contract, and the bounds hint conveys the min/max selectable range. No DOM elements, lucide-react, react-day-picker, Recharts, Leaflet, old web UI imports, API paths, or unit conversions were introduced; styling uses StyleSheet + existing theme tokens and AppText only.

Covered by __tests__/RangePicker.test.tsx: trigger active-preset label + open toggle; preset press fires onChange(range,presetId) and closes; staged TextInput edits stage and Apply commits onChange({start,end}) (Apply disabled until dirty); Cancel discards; compare toggle fires onCompareChange; presetsOnly hides the staged fields/footer; presetIds override renders the chosen subset.
